Require final head revision3 and exact sets; do not require public lookups to resolve private targets. recovery.freshness: Await actor.close() before replacement. Retain same disposable secret/salt/signing key only in trusted parent memory and public verified artifacts/deployment. Use new dataDirectory and new empty storageDirectory. Assert new SDK DB name absent via indexedDB.databases and directory empty BEFORE constructor. Do not import previous journal/cache/notes or replace global IDBFactory shared with other actors.
recovery.keysOnlyMeaning: Same in-memory recovered key material drives a genuinely new PXE and preference cache; not mnemonic entry or device/browser persistence acceptance. CLI currently uses real SDK IndexedDB adapter atop fake-indexeddb platform.
recovery.counters: Before close through replacement creation and completed preference read: global real prover submitted and transport sends unchanged, fresh actor walletSubmissions0; separately record permitted local auth-witness simulation. Head/private event records remain RAM-only.
recovery.journal: Run original actor confirmed-journal reopen before closing. Empty replacement journal cannot reconcile the old absent workflow intent; do not route it through generic fixture journal-reopen loop or fabricate retained transactions. Parent must update active actor handles for subsequent incremental action and cleanup.

incremental.required: Record official getPrivateEvents calls without modifying results; query fromBlock starts1, later resumes canonical encrypted checkpoint+1; each range<=32, rows<=512. Require actual complete result after final head change.
incremental.multiStep: If genuine anchor<=32, do not invent pagination: separate zero-proof canonical empty-checkpoint advance using existing createT04CheckpointScope/drainT04Checkpoints under real-wall mining, bounded by remaining campaign deadline. No lowered PXE anchor or header override.
incremental.caveat: Head utility can trigger full cold contract discovery before event page reading. Explicitly measure that stage; bounded query/fold is not bounded end-to-end sync.

reorg.proposal: Use supported EthCheatCodes.reorg/reorgWithReplacement (ethereum/src/test/eth_cheat_codes.ts437+) on unfinalized L1 blocks while parent real-wall miner and sequencer are quiesced. Resume normal archiver/world state and build canonical replacement checkpoints at same heights; preserve setup/funding. Native rollbackTo alone is not chain authority.
reorg.source: aztec-node/src/aztec-node/server.ts972+ rollbackTo forbids before-finalized unless force; never force. pxe block_synchronizer.ts115-155 rolls stores back transactionally before advancing tips.
reorg.acceptance: Authenticated old prefix invalidated by changed canonical block hash; actual private head and rebuilt events match new chain, no orphaned subscription/read-marker suppression or automatic resubmit. Need genuine replacement block at cached height: missing block is unavailable and correctly fails, not reorg proof.
reorg.risk: No existing fixture reorg campaign found; interface exists but requires separate reviewed parent control and measured run. Do not mix epoch timestamp warp into trusted-freshness recovery.
